findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The earlier finding was dismissed because this fix did not change `events.ts`; the current diff now adds this occurrence check. When a failed workflow is rerun and the busy turn ends within 60 seconds, `board.py:101` can still return the cached failed snapshot. The old workflow ID remains in `latest`, so this check submits the stale failure. The new rerun test advances `FORGE_NOW` by a full minute before reading the rerun, bypassing that normal interval.
